crossRefs.note: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come…
I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread…
No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will…
Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

translations.web: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

translations.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
